shops.name: The Bean Flower
shops.note: Menu mentions matcha: milk tea (first-harvest Kagoshima and Uji) and limeade; add a matcha shot $1.50
shops.notes: Boba and dessert cafe (dou hua, taho, fizzes), opened summer 2024 by CC Chu (Durham Magazine profile). Address, hours (Wed-Sun 11am-8pm, last call 7:30pm) and @thebeanflower are on its own site; the menu is a picture dated 3.31.2026 on /menu: Matcha milk tea $8 (ceremonial grade), Matcha Limeade $7.50 under specialty, add 1 oz matcha shot $1.50. Two matcha drinks, so tier serves, not a matcha bar. Site prints no phone, so null.
